Who Can Partner

Partnership Types

We welcome partnerships across multiple collaboration models.

Technology Partners

OEM vendors, hardware/software manufacturers and technology innovators whose products power ATLINE's infrastructure solutions.

System Integrators

Certified integrators with complementary technical expertise who collaborate on end-to-end ICT infrastructure project delivery.

Channel & Resellers

Authorised resellers and channel partners who extend ATLINE's product and solution reach across Malaysia's government and private sectors.

Joint Venture

Formal joint ventures established to pursue large-scale or complex ICT infrastructure opportunities requiring combined expertise and capital.

Subcontractors

Specialised technical contractors who execute defined scopes of work within ATLINE-led projects under formal subcontract agreements.

Training Partners

Academic institutions, training bodies and certification centres who collaborate on skills development programmes for ICT professionals.

Why Partner With Us

Partnership Benefits

What you gain when you partner with ATLINE SDN BHD.

Revenue Growth

Tap into ATLINE's established government and enterprise project pipeline to accelerate your revenue growth.

Market Visibility

Co-branding, joint marketing initiatives and listing on ATLINE's partner directory to elevate your brand presence.

Shared Expertise

Leverage ATLINE's 100+ years of combined ICT engineering experience to strengthen your technical delivery capability.

Priority Referrals

Receive direct business referrals and tender invitations for opportunities that align with your capabilities.
